import os, json, csv, math, hashlib, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import cv2
import scipy
from scipy.interpolate import PchipInterpolator
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from skimage.morphology import skeletonize
import skimage
import networkx as nx
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import font_manager
from matplotlib.patches import Polygon

OUT=Path(r"D:\论文复现\experiments\two_pass_demo_20261016")
OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for d in ["frames","masks","mapping","repair","figures","provenance"]: (OUT/d).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
font_manager.fontManager.addfont(r"C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc")
plt.rcParams.update({"font.family":"Microsoft YaHei","axes.unicode_minus":False,"font.size":10})
rng=np.random.default_rng(42)
W,H=600.,250.
S=.5
GW,GH=1200,500
IW,IH=520,440
CX,CY=260.,220.
CAM_OFFSET=np.array([30.,0.])
G=np.array([[1/S,0,0],[0,-1/S,H/S],[0,0,1.]])
def dump(p,obj):
    (OUT/p).write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
def write_csv(p,header,rows):
    with (OUT/p).open("w",newline="",encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        w=csv.writer(f);w.writerow(header);w.writerows(rows)
def saveimg(p,im):
    a=im
    if a.ndim==3: a=cv2.cvtColor(a,cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
    ok,buf=cv2.imencode(".png",a)
    assert ok
    (OUT/p).write_bytes(buf.tobytes())
def transform(M,xy):
    xy=np.asarray(xy,float).reshape(-1,2)
    out=np.c_[xy,np.ones(len(xy))]@M.T
    return out[:,:2]/out[:,2,None]
def rot(deg):
    t=np.deg2rad(deg)
    return np.array([[np.cos(t),-np.sin(t)],[np.sin(t),np.cos(t)]])
def camera_h(center,deg):
    R=rot(deg)
    A=R@np.diag([S,-S])
    b=np.asarray(center)-A@np.array([CX,CY])
    return np.array([[A[0,0],A[0,1],b[0]],[A[1,0],A[1,1],b[1]],[0,0,1.]])
def image_from_world(im,Hc,binary=False):
    M=np.linalg.inv(Hc)@np.linalg.inv(G)
    return cv2.warpPerspective(im,M,(IW,IH),flags=cv2.INTER_NEAREST if binary else cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,borderValue=0)
# Synthetic scene geometry, used as virtual camera environment and evaluation reference.
xp=np.array([70,120,180,240,300,360,420,470.])
yp=np.array([100,116,105,127,136,114,139,130.])
curve=PchipInterpolator(xp,yp)
mx=np.linspace(70,470,1601)
main=np.c_[mx,curve(mx)]
bx=np.linspace(280,380,501)
branch=np.c_[bx,PchipInterpolator([280,320,350,380],[float(curve(280)),170,187,200])(bx)]
mask=np.zeros((GH,GW),np.uint8)
for pts,width in [(main,3.),(branch,2.)]:
    pix=np.rint(transform(G,pts)).astype(np.int32)
    cv2.polylines(mask,[pix],False,255,int(round(width/S)),cv2.LINE_8)
road=np.clip(148+rng.normal(0,9,(GH,GW)),0,255)
road=cv2.GaussianBlur(road.astype(np.float32),(3,3),.5)
road[mask>0]=np.clip(35+rng.normal(0,3,int((mask>0).sum())),0,255)
road=np.repeat(road.astype(np.uint8)[:,:,None],3,axis=2)
markers=[]
for x in [20,100,180,260,340,420,500,580]:
    for y in [30,220]:
        markers.append([x,y])
markers=np.array(markers,float)
# Small color control marks outside the crack, only for visual understanding.
for i,p in enumerate(markers):
    x,y=np.rint(transform(G,[p])[0]).astype(int)
    cv2.rectangle(road,(x-6,y-6),(x+6,y+6),(32,170,125),-1)
    cv2.putText(road,str(i+1),(x+8,y+4),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.35,(20,80,50),1,cv2.LINE_AA)
saveimg("synthetic_road.png",road)
saveimg("synthetic_truth_mask.png",mask)
write_csv("ground_control_points_SIMULATED.csv",["id","X_mm","Y_mm","Z_mm","source"],
 [[i+1,*p,0,"synthetic_exact_not_measured"] for i,p in enumerate(markers)])
write_csv("synthetic_reference_centerlines.csv",["branch","X_mm","Y_mm"],
 [["main",*p] for p in main]+[["branch",*p] for p in branch])
controls=[]
fits=[]
def estimate_h(Htrue,frameid):
    pix=transform(np.linalg.inv(Htrue),markers)
    visible=(pix[:,0]>12)&(pix[:,0]<IW-12)&(pix[:,1]>12)&(pix[:,1]<IH-12)
    ids=np.where(visible)[0]
    assert len(ids)>=6,(frameid,len(ids))
    # The outer two visible columns define 4 fit points. Others are held out.
    fitids=np.array([ids[0],ids[1],ids[-2],ids[-1]])
    checkids=np.array([i for i in ids if i not in fitids])
    est,_=cv2.findHomography(pix[fitids],markers[fitids],method=0)
    assert est is not None and abs(np.linalg.det(est))>1e-10
    e=np.linalg.norm(transform(est,pix[checkids])-markers[checkids],axis=1)
    roundtrip=np.linalg.norm(transform(np.linalg.inv(est),transform(est,pix[ids]))-pix[ids],axis=1)
    center=transform(est,[[CX,CY]])[0]
    axis=transform(est,[[CX+10,CY]])[0]-center
    deg=float(np.rad2deg(np.arctan2(axis[1],axis[0])))
    for i in ids:
        controls.append([frameid,int(i+1),float(pix[i,0]),float(pix[i,1]),*markers[i],
          "fit" if i in fitids else "heldout_check","synthetic_exact_correspondence"])
    fits.append({"frame_id":frameid,"fit_count":len(fitids),"heldout_count":len(checkids),
      "heldout_rmse_mm":float(np.sqrt(np.mean(e**2))),"heldout_max_mm":float(e.max()),
      "roundtrip_max_px":float(roundtrip.max()),"H_pixel_to_world_mm":est.tolist(),
      "estimated_camera_center_mm":center.tolist(),"estimated_yaw_deg":deg})
    return est,center,deg
scan_centers=[np.array([130.,125.]),np.array([300.,125.]),np.array([470.,125.])]
fused=np.zeros_like(mask);observed=np.zeros_like(mask);counts=np.zeros(mask.shape,np.uint8)
frame_imgs=[];frame_masks=[];map_states=[];pose_rows=[]
for i,c in enumerate(scan_centers,1):
    fid=f"scan_{i:03d}";ht=camera_h(c,0)
    im=image_from_world(road,ht);m=image_from_world(mask,ht,True)
    he,ce,ye=estimate_h(ht,fid)
    saveimg(f"frames/{fid}.png",im);saveimg(f"masks/{fid}_IDEAL_NOT_SEGFORMER.png",m)
    warped=cv2.warpPerspective(m,G@he,(GW,GH),flags=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
    obs=cv2.warpPerspective(np.full_like(m,255),G@he,(GW,GH),flags=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
    fused=np.maximum(fused,warped);observed=np.maximum(observed,obs);counts+=(obs>0).astype(np.uint8)
    frame_imgs.append(im);frame_masks.append(m);map_states.append(fused.copy())
    pose_rows.append([fid,(i-1)*5.,*ce,500.,ye,0.,0.,"synthetic_exact_control_points"])
saveimg("mapping/fused_mask.png",fused);saveimg("mapping/observed_area.png",observed)
saveimg("mapping/observation_count.png",(counts*80).astype(np.uint8))
write_csv("scan_pose_log_SIMULATED.csv",
 ["frame_id","capture_relative_s","camera_X_mm","camera_Y_mm","camera_height_mm","yaw_deg","tilt_x_deg","tilt_y_deg","pose_source"],pose_rows)
skel=skeletonize(fused>0)
saveimg("mapping/full_skeleton.png",(skel*255).astype(np.uint8))
ys,xs=np.where(skel)
world_skel=transform(np.linalg.inv(G),np.c_[xs,ys])
write_csv("mapping/all_skeleton_points_mm.csv",["X_mm","Y_mm"],world_skel)
ref_skel=skeletonize(mask>0)
ry,rx=np.where(ref_skel)
ref_world=transform(np.linalg.inv(G),np.c_[rx,ry])
ref_tree=cKDTree(ref_world)
def pixel_graph(binary):
    yy,xx=np.where(binary)
    nodes=list(zip(yy.tolist(),xx.tolist()))
    g=nx.Graph();g.add_nodes_from(nodes);ns=set(nodes)
    for y,x in nodes:
        for dy,dx in [(0,1),(1,-1),(1,0),(1,1)]:
            q=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if q in ns: g.add_edge((y,x),q,weight=float(np.hypot(dy,dx))*S)
    return g
global_graph=pixel_graph(skel)
global_tree=nx.minimum_spanning_tree(global_graph)
ends=[n for n in global_tree if global_tree.degree(n)==1]
juncmask=np.zeros_like(skel)
for n in global_tree:
    if global_tree.degree(n)>=3:juncmask[n]=True
from scipy.ndimage import label,binary_dilation
junction_groups=int(label(binary_dilation(juncmask,iterations=1))[1])
end_world=transform(np.linalg.inv(G),np.array([[n[1],n[0]] for n in ends]))
# Three repair windows. A camera is 30 mm forward of the XYZ origin, not co-located.
nominal_bases=[np.array([130.,125.]),np.array([280.,125.]),np.array([430.,125.])]
errors=[(8.,-6.,3.),(-5.,7.,-2.),(6.,4.,2.)]
limits=np.array([100.,90.])
all_good=[];all_blind=[];repair_info=[];all_on=[];trajectories=[];repair_views=[]
station_ranges=[(-np.inf,205.),(205.,355.),(355.,np.inf)]
for i,(base,err) in enumerate(zip(nominal_bases,errors),1):
    dx,dy,ang=err;actual_base=base+np.array([dx,dy])
    actual_camera=actual_base+rot(ang)@CAM_OFFSET
    ht=camera_h(actual_camera,ang)
    fid=f"repair_{i:03d}"
    im=image_from_world(road,ht);m=image_from_world(mask,ht,True)
    he,estimated_cam,estimated_yaw=estimate_h(ht,fid)
    estimated_base=estimated_cam-rot(estimated_yaw)@CAM_OFFSET
    ls=skeletonize(m>0);yy,xx=np.where(ls)
    all_pix=np.c_[xx,yy].astype(float)
    world_est=transform(he,all_pix)
    body_est=(world_est-estimated_base)@rot(estimated_yaw)
    lo,hi=station_ranges[i-1]
    owned=(world_est[:,0]>=lo)&(world_est[:,0]<hi)
    reachable=(np.abs(body_est)<=limits).all(axis=1)
    assert (reachable[owned]).all(),(fid,int((owned&~reachable).sum()))
    ownmask=np.zeros_like(ls);ownmask[yy[owned],xx[owned]]=True
    tree=nx.minimum_spanning_tree(pixel_graph(ownmask))
    # Convert only the estimated local image geometry into the XYZ planar frame.
    # True parking error enters observation synthesis and evaluation, not this conversion.
    node_xyz={}
    for node in tree:
        q=transform(he,[[node[1],node[0]]])[0]
        node_xyz[node]=(q-estimated_base)@rot(estimated_yaw)
    rows=[];station_paths=[];lastpoint=None;state=None;seq=0;drawn_edges=set()
    def emit(pt,z,pen,component,action):
        nonlocal_dummy=0
        rows.append([i,len(rows),component,float(pt[0]),float(pt[1]),float(z),int(pen),action,"XYZ_base","mm",True,False])
    comps=list(nx.connected_components(tree))
    comps.sort(key=lambda comp:min(n[1] for n in comp))
    for ci,comp in enumerate(comps):
        sub=tree.subgraph(comp)
        endpoints=[n for n in sub if sub.degree(n)<=1]
        root=min(endpoints or list(comp),key=lambda n:(n[1],n[0]))
        current=root
        emit(node_xyz[root],10,False,ci,"pen_up_transfer")
        state=False
        current_path=[]
        for u,v,event in nx.dfs_labeled_edges(sub,source=root):
            if u==v:continue
            if event=="forward": start,end,on=u,v,True
            elif event=="reverse": start,end,on=v,u,False
            else: continue
            assert current==start,(fid,current,start)
            if state!=on:
                emit(node_xyz[start],0 if on else 10,on,ci,"lower" if on else "lift")
                state=on
            emit(node_xyz[end],0 if on else 10,on,ci,"trace" if on else "return_pen_up")
            if on:
                key=frozenset([start,end]);assert key not in drawn_edges
                drawn_edges.add(key)
                a,b=node_xyz[start],node_xyz[end]
                step=float(np.linalg.norm(a-b))
                assert step<=S*np.sqrt(2)+1e-3,(fid,step)
                station_paths.append((a.copy(),b.copy()))
            current=end
        if state:emit(node_xyz[current],10,False,ci,"lift")
    assert len(drawn_edges)==tree.number_of_edges()
    pts=np.array([p for a,b in station_paths for p in (a,b)])
    good=actual_base+pts@rot(ang).T
    # Same desired points, naively interpreted using the nominal parking pose.
    desired=estimated_base+pts@rot(estimated_yaw).T
    blind_cmd=desired-base
    blind=actual_base+blind_cmd@rot(ang).T
    dg=ref_tree.query(good)[0];db=ref_tree.query(blind)[0]
    all_good.extend(dg.tolist());all_blind.extend(db.tolist());all_on.extend(good.tolist())
    inside=[]
    for a,b in station_paths:
        mid=(a+b)/2
        midworld=estimated_base+rot(estimated_yaw)@mid
        uv=transform(np.linalg.inv(he),[midworld])[0]
        uu,vv=np.rint(uv).astype(int)
        inside.append(0<=uu<IW and 0<=vv<IH and m[vv,uu]>0)
    assert all(inside)
    saveimg(f"repair/{fid}_image.png",im);saveimg(f"repair/{fid}_IDEAL_mask.png",m)
    saveimg(f"repair/{fid}_owned_skeleton.png",(ownmask*255).astype(np.uint8))
    write_csv(f"repair/station_{i}_trajectory_SIMULATION_ONLY.csv",
      ["station","sequence","component","X_mm","Y_mm","Z_mm_ASSUMED","pen_down","action","coordinate_frame","unit","simulation_only","hardware_execution_allowed"],rows)
    trajectories.extend(rows)
    rinfo={"station":i,"nominal_base_mm":base.tolist(),"actual_base_mm":actual_base.tolist(),
      "injected_error_dx_dy_yaw":[dx,dy,ang],"estimated_base_mm":estimated_base.tolist(),
      "estimated_yaw_deg":estimated_yaw,"base_estimation_error_mm":float(np.linalg.norm(estimated_base-actual_base)),
      "estimated_yaw_error_deg":float(estimated_yaw-ang),"owned_skeleton_pixels":int(ownmask.sum()),
      "components":len(comps),"tree_edges":tree.number_of_edges(),"traced_edges":len(drawn_edges),
      "trajectory_rows":len(rows),"all_pen_down_midpoints_inside_local_mask":all(inside),
      "all_points_reachable":bool(reachable[owned].all()),"before_median_mm":float(np.median(db)),
      "before_p95_mm":float(np.percentile(db,95)),"after_median_mm":float(np.median(dg)),
      "after_p95_mm":float(np.percentile(dg,95))}
    repair_info.append(rinfo)
    repair_views.append((im,m,ownmask,pts,good,blind,rows))
write_csv("repair/all_stations_trajectory_SIMULATION_ONLY.csv",
 ["station","sequence","component","X_mm","Y_mm","Z_mm_ASSUMED","pen_down","action","coordinate_frame","unit","simulation_only","hardware_execution_allowed"],trajectories)
write_csv("frame_control_point_observations_SIMULATED.csv",
 ["frame_id","point_id","u_px","v_px","world_X_mm","world_Y_mm","role","source"],controls)
dump("mapping/per_frame_transforms.json",fits)
dump("repair/station_results.json",repair_info)
covered=cKDTree(np.asarray(all_on)).query(ref_world)[0]<=1.5
iou=float(np.logical_and(fused>0,mask>0).sum()/np.logical_or(fused>0,mask>0).sum())
summary={
 "status":"completed_synthetic_geometry_demo","simulation_only":True,"segformer_inference_run":False,
 "segmentation_source":"oracle_mask_from_synthetic_scene_geometry_NOT_neural_network_prediction",
 "real_camera_calibration":False,"real_robot_control":False,"test_dataset_accessed":False,
 "seed":42,"plane_size_mm":[W,H],"map_resolution_mm_per_px":S,
 "camera":{"resolution_px":[IW,IH],"height_mm":500,"fx_fy_px":[1000,1000],"principal_point_px":[CX,CY],"distortion":"assumed_zero","fov_mm":[260,220],"offset_from_XYZ_base_mm":CAM_OFFSET.tolist()},
 "crack_main_extent_X_mm":[70,470],"crack_main_curve_length_mm":float(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(main,axis=0),axis=1).sum()),
 "branch_curve_length_mm":float(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(branch,axis=0),axis=1).sum()),
 "scan_frames":3,"observed_area_fraction":float((observed>0).mean()),"unobserved_is_not_background":True,
 "synthetic_map_mask_iou":iou,"global_skeleton_pixels":int(skel.sum()),
 "global_skeleton_components":nx.number_connected_components(global_graph),
 "global_tree_endpoints":len(ends),"global_tree_junction_groups":junction_groups,
 "repair_stations":3,"trajectory_rows":len(trajectories),
 "covered_reference_skeleton_fraction_within_1p5mm":float(covered.mean()),
 "reference_distance_before":{"median_mm":float(np.median(all_blind)),"p95_mm":float(np.percentile(all_blind,95))},
 "reference_distance_after":{"median_mm":float(np.median(all_good)),"p95_mm":float(np.percentile(all_good,95))},
 "heldout_control_point_max_mm":max(f["heldout_max_mm"] for f in fits),
 "notes":["All measurements are synthetic. No accuracy claims for SegFormer, calibration, localization or robot.",
 "Camera control point observations are generated exactly, not detected from image; numerical residuals only.",
 "Z=0 contact and Z=10 lift are illustrative assumptions, not measured tool heights.",
 "NetworkX minimum spanning forest and depth-first traversal are demonstration routing, not globally optimal planning.",
 "Each tree edge is traced once, return/disconnected transfers are pen-up; all raster skeleton components retained.",
 "No obstacle, time dynamics, slip, backlash, depth, material flow or controller modeled.",
 "World/XYZ X forward, Y left; image u follows local X, v follows negative local Y, camera optical axis down."],
 "library_versions":{"opencv":cv2.__version__,"numpy":np.__version__,"scipy":scipy.__version__,"skimage":skimage.__version__,"networkx":nx.__version__,"matplotlib":matplotlib.__version__}}
dump("results.json",summary)
# Scientific visualizations. All titles explicitly describe simulation.
colors=["#1479B8","#DA8132","#6F59B5"]
def ground(ax,bg=True):
    if bg:ax.imshow(road,extent=[0,W,0,H],origin="upper")
    ax.set_xlim(0,W);ax.set_ylim(0,H);ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.set_xlabel("场地 X / mm");ax.set_ylabel("场地 Y / mm")
    ax.grid(alpha=.17)
def plot_mask(ax,data,color="#EF504C",size=2):
    yy,xx=np.where(data>0);p=transform(np.linalg.inv(G),np.c_[xx,yy])
    ax.scatter(p[:,0],p[:,1],s=size,c=color,lw=0)
def fov_polygon(center,angle,half=(130,110)):
    p=np.array([[-half[0],-half[1]],[half[0],-half[1]],[half[0],half[1]],[-half[0],half[1]]])
    return center+p@rot(angle).T
fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,3,figsize=(14,8.2),layout="constrained")
for i in range(3):
    axs[0,i].imshow(frame_imgs[i]);axs[0,i].axis("off")
    axs[0,i].set_title(f"第{i+1}次拍照：相机 X={scan_centers[i][0]:.0f} mm")
    axs[1,i].imshow(frame_masks[i],cmap="gray",vmin=0,vmax=255);axs[1,i].axis("off")
    axs[1,i].set_title("理想分割掩膜（代替模型输出）")
fig.suptitle("三次拍照 → 三张裂缝掩膜\n合成教学数据；未运行 SegFormer",fontsize=17,fontweight="bold")
fig.savefig(OUT/"figures/01_scan_frames_and_masks.png",dpi=170);plt.close(fig)
fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,3,figsize=(16,6.6),layout="constrained")
ax=axs[0,0];ground(ax);ax.set_title("① 假设一条弯曲裂缝，带一个分叉")
ax.scatter(markers[:,0],markers[:,1],marker="s",facecolors="none",edgecolors="#00E6A8",s=32)
ax.text(10,242,"绿色点：坐标已知的地面参照点",fontsize=9,va="top",color="black",bbox=dict(fc="white",alpha=.8,ec="none"))
ax=axs[0,1];ground(ax);ax.set_title("② 第一遍扫描：停稳拍三张")
for i,c in enumerate(scan_centers):
    ax.add_patch(Polygon(fov_polygon(c,0),fill=False,ec=colors[i],lw=2))
    ax.scatter(*c,c=colors[i],s=40);ax.text(c[0],c[1]+16,str(i+1),color=colors[i],weight="bold")
ax.plot([p[0] for p in scan_centers],[125]*3,"k--",lw=1)
ax=axs[0,2];ground(ax,False);ax.set_title("③ 用每帧坐标变换，拼合裂缝地图")
ax.imshow(np.where(observed>0,.93,.55),extent=[0,W,0,H],origin="upper",cmap="gray",vmin=0,vmax=1)
plot_mask(ax,fused,size=2)
ax.text(8,242,"灰色边带=未观测，不能当作无裂缝",fontsize=8,va="top")
ax=axs[1,0];ground(ax,False);ax.set_title("④ 提取骨架，保留主干和分叉")
plot_mask(ax,skel,color="#146F9B",size=3)
ax.scatter(end_world[:,0],end_world[:,1],c="#E46C2F",s=45,zorder=5)
ax.text(8,240,f"{len(ends)} 个端点；{junction_groups} 个分叉区域",fontsize=10,va="top")
ax=axs[1,1];ground(ax,False);ax.set_title("⑤ 第二遍：依次停在三个修复工位")
plot_mask(ax,fused,color="#444",size=1.5)
for i,b in enumerate(nominal_bases):
    ax.add_patch(Polygon(fov_polygon(b,0,limits),fill=False,ec=colors[i],lw=1.8))
    a=np.array(repair_info[i]["actual_base_mm"])
    ax.scatter(*b,c=colors[i],marker="x",s=65);ax.scatter(*a,c=colors[i],marker="o",s=25)
    ax.annotate(f"工位{i+1}",(b[0],35),ha="center",color=colors[i])
ax.text(8,242,"×计划位置  ●实际位置；矩形为假设三轴范围",fontsize=8,va="top")
ax=axs[1,2];ground(ax,False);ax.set_title("⑥ 局部重拍后，生成分段修复轨迹")
